case.query: I have two separate questions: I was told I might have a pheochromocytoma; what are some of the physical symptoms caused by the extra hormones this tumor produces? I heard antibiotics are often used for infections, but will they help if I have a viral infection like the flu?
evidence: This can lead to high blood pressure and cause symptoms such as : Headaches Sweating Pounding of the heart Being shaky Being extremely pale Sometimes pheochromocytoma is part of another condition called multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome (MEN).
Antibiotics do not work for viral infections.
